method: Contract shares traded in the session used for the forecast. For hourly archives, volume sums the observed trading hours on that New York date. Partially archived dates can understate activity.
periodMethod: Periods use the reported trading date. Intraday observations are assigned to the New York trading date.
cumulativeMethod: Sum of recorded same-contract trading-session volumes through the forecast date. Source windows vary; missing sessions, including incomplete hourly archives, can understate trading since listing.
